$comment: The garden catalog (v0.5): the Gardening skill, the Garden buy category with its groups, garden feelings and plants. Models: tools/art/garden_models.py.

objects.name: Maple tree
objects.description: A dense, round crown of fresh green maple leaves. Gives deep shade on summer afternoons.

objects.name: Silver birch
objects.description: White bark and an airy crown of small leaves that flicker in every breeze.

objects.name: Cherry blossom tree
objects.description: A low, spreading crown covered in pink blossom.

objects.name: Apple tree
objects.description: A compact fruit tree. Pick a fresh apple whenever someone is peckish; good gardeners get more out of it.

objects.name: Japanese maple
objects.description: A small, layered tree with deep red leaves: the star of any garden.

objects.name: Magnolia
objects.description: Big, pale pink goblet flowers on an open crown.

objects.name: Weeping willow
objects.description: Long green curtains of willow sweep down to the lawn. A private spot to sit beneath.

objects.name: Blue spruce
objects.description: A dense, regular conifer with blue-green needles; evergreen.

objects.name: Italian cypress
objects.description: A slim, dark green column. Plant a row of them along a path.

objects.name: Potted lemon tree
objects.description: A little lemon tree in a terracotta pot, happy indoors or out. Pick a lemon for a fresh boost.

objects.name: Boxwood ball
objects.description: A neatly clipped evergreen ball.

objects.name: Topiary cone
objects.description: A clipped boxwood cone in a slate planter, at home on a porch or in a hall.

objects.name: Clipped hedge
objects.description: One metre of dense, clipped hedge. Put several in a row for a green wall.

objects.name: Hydrangea
objects.description: Big blue-violet flower balls all summer long.

objects.name: Rose bush
objects.description: Deep red roses. Stop and smell them now and then.

objects.name: Azalea
objects.description: A mound of small leaves smothered in bright pink flowers.

objects.name: Lavender
objects.description: Silvery leaves and purple spikes that smell of summer; bees love it.

objects.name: Garden fern
objects.description: Arching green fronds for a shady corner.

objects.name: Ornamental grass
objects.description: A fountain of fine blades with soft, feathery plumes.

objects.name: Hosta
objects.description: Broad blue-green leaves and pale lilac flower spikes.

objects.name: Tulips
objects.description: A bed of tulips in red, yellow, pink and white.

objects.name: Daffodils
objects.description: Cheerful yellow trumpets, the first sign of spring.

objects.name: Daisies
objects.description: A carpet of white daisies with sunny centres.

objects.name: Sunflowers
objects.description: Tall sunflowers taller than anyone in town.

objects.name: Poppies
objects.description: Bright red poppies dancing on thin stems.

objects.name: Marigolds
objects.description: Low mounds of orange and yellow pompoms. Easy to grow.

objects.name: Pansies
objects.description: Little faces in purple, yellow and white.

objects.name: Lilies
objects.description: Tall stems of orange and pink lilies with a heady scent.

objects.name: Lupins
objects.description: Towering spikes of purple, pink and white over palm-shaped leaves.

objects.name: Forget-me-nots
objects.description: A cloud of tiny sky-blue flowers.

objects.name: Cosmos
objects.description: Airy pink, white and magenta flowers above feathery leaves.

objects.name: Wildflower meadow
objects.description: A patch of long grass and wildflowers. No mowing needed.

objects.name: Potted geraniums
objects.description: Red geraniums in a terracotta pot, for a doorstep or a sunny window.

objects.name: Flower box
objects.description: A painted planter spilling over with petunias.

objects.name: Vegetable patch
objects.description: Rows of lettuce, carrots and cabbages. Harvest a fresh, free meal; good gardeners get more out of it.

objects.name: Tomato plants
objects.description: Staked tomato plants heavy with red and orange fruit.

objects.name: Strawberry bed
objects.description: A low bed of strawberries: a sweet snack straight from the garden.

objects.name: Herb planter
objects.description: Basil, rosemary and chives in a raised planter. Fresh herbs make anyone a better cook for a while.

objects.name: Pumpkin patch
objects.description: Sprawling leaves and fat orange pumpkins.

objects.name: Monstera
objects.description: Big split leaves in a white pot: instant jungle.

objects.name: Fiddle-leaf fig
objects.description: A tall indoor tree with big, glossy leaves.

objects.name: Snake plant
objects.description: Upright striped leaves. Almost impossible to kill.

objects.name: Cactus trio
objects.description: Three little cacti in terracotta pots, one of them in bloom.

objects.name: Succulent bowl
objects.description: A glazed bowl of rosette succulents in soft colours.

objects.name: Fern on a stand
objects.description: A Boston fern spilling over its pot on a wooden plant stand.

objects.name: Parlour palm
objects.description: Soft, arching palm fronds for a bright corner.

objects.name: Orchid
objects.description: White and pink orchids on a slim plant stand.

objects.name: Bonsai
objects.description: A tiny, patient tree. Pruning it trains Gardening and Creativity, and a skilled hand finds real calm in it.

objects.name: Bird bath
objects.description: A stone bird bath. Visitors guaranteed.

objects.name: Stone fountain
objects.description: A two-tier stone fountain. Toss a coin and make a wish, or just listen to the water.

interactions.label: Toss a coin and make a wish

objects.name: Garden gnome
objects.description: He guards the flower beds. Pat his hat for luck.

objects.name: Garden pond
objects.description: A round pond with water lilies, reeds and a few goldfish.

objects.name: Stone lantern
objects.description: A Japanese-style stone lantern.

objects.name: Wheelbarrow planter
objects.description: An old wheelbarrow, retired and full of flowers.

objects.name: Garden boulders
objects.description: Three weathered stones in the grass.
